overview.en: The Cuban fruit-eating bat is a medium-sized phyllostomid of the Greater Antilles, found on Cuba, Hispaniola, Grand Cayman and Middle Caicos; fossil remains are known from Jamaica.
overview.fr: Le murciélago frutero cubano est un phyllostomidé de taille moyenne des Grandes Antilles, présent à Cuba, Hispaniola, Grand Cayman et Middle Caicos ; des fossiles sont connus de Jamaïque.

identification.en: Its short, pig-like muzzle and reduced noseleaf help distinguish it from the sympatric Cuban flower bat Phyllonycteris poeyi, which has a conspicuous uropatagial spur.
identification.fr: Son museau court évoquant celui d’un porc et sa feuille nasale réduite le distinguent du phyllonyctère de Cuba Phyllonycteris poeyi, qui possède un éperon uropatagial bien visible.

habitat.en: It roosts in caves; in Cuba it often occupies deep, warm and humid chambers, while in Middle Caicos it uses a wider range of cooler caves where deep caverns are scarce.
habitat.fr: Elle se repose dans des grottes ; à Cuba, elle occupe souvent des salles profondes, chaudes et humides, tandis qu’à Middle Caicos elle utilise aussi des cavités plus fraîches, les grottes profondes y étant rares.

diet.en: It is an omnivorous flower visitor whose diet includes pollen, nectar, fruits, seeds and insects. A Cuban study found that flower-visiting bat species partition floral resources, with diets and visitation rates differing among species.
diet.fr: C’est un visiteur omnivore des fleurs qui mange pollen, nectar, fruits, graines et insectes. Une étude cubaine a montré que les chauves-souris visiteuses de fleurs se partagent les ressources florales, avec des régimes et des fréquences de visite différents.

behavior.en: It forms cave-roosting colonies and uses echolocation when flying; research on Cuban colonies has also documented social distress calls and responses to them.
behavior.fr: Elle forme des colonies dans les grottes et utilise l’écholocation en vol ; des travaux menés dans des colonies cubaines ont aussi décrit des cris de détresse sociaux et les réponses qu’ils déclenchent.

reproduction.en: Females form maternity groups and usually give birth to one young; reported birth periods extend across winter and spring, although timing varies among islands.
reproduction.fr: Les femelles forment des groupes de maternité et mettent généralement bas un seul petit ; les naissances sont signalées de l’hiver au printemps, avec des variations entre les îles.

ecology.en: It shares its genus with the larger B. cavernarum, found from Puerto Rico through the Lesser Antilles; within Cuban cave communities it overlaps with nectar-feeding relatives such as Phyllonycteris poeyi but differs in diet breadth.
ecology.fr: Elle partage son genre avec B. cavernarum, plus grande et présente de Porto Rico aux Petites Antilles ; dans les grottes cubaines, elle côtoie des parents nectarivores comme Phyllonycteris poeyi, mais son régime est plus varié.

conservation.en: Mammal Diversity Database and the Cuban species account report Least Concern; cave disturbance and colony counts nevertheless deserve monitoring because many individuals can depend on a small number of roosts.
conservation.fr: La Mammal Diversity Database et la fiche cubaine indiquent la catégorie Préoccupation mineure ; le dérangement des grottes et les effectifs des colonies méritent néanmoins un suivi, car de nombreux individus peuvent dépendre de quelques gîtes.

title.fr: Brachyphylla nana — Animal Diversity Web (fiche en anglais)

facts: The species account gives the island range, cave roosting, differences in cave microclimate, broad diet, colony habits and reproductive observations.

title.en: Revision of the Antillean Bats of the Genus Brachyphylla — University of Nebraska
title.fr: Révision des chauves-souris antillaises du genre Brachyphylla — Université du Nebraska

facts: The taxonomic revision recognizes B. nana and B. cavernarum as the two genus species, distinguishes their ranges and discusses morphology and variation.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Morphology, Diet and Flower-visiting by Phyllostomid Bats in Cuba — Biotropica
title.fr: Morphologie, régime et visites florales des chauves-souris phyllostomidées de Cuba — Biotropica

facts: The study analysed guano and flower visits by B. nana and other Cuban bats, finding partitioning of floral resources among species.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Assessing the Structure and Function of Distress Calls in Cuban Fruit-Eating Bats — Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution
title.fr: Structure et fonction des cris de détresse chez le murciélago frutero cubano — Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution

facts: The 2022 study documents distress and echolocation calls from B. nana individuals in Cuban cave colonies.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Murciélago hocico de cerdo — RELCOM regional bat account
title.fr: Murciélago hocico de cerdo — fiche régionale RELCOM (espagnol)

facts: The Spanish account names B. nana murciélago gritón or hocico de cerdo, reports Least Concern and describes its distinction from Phyllonycteris poeyi.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Detailed seasonality of breeding varies by island and is based largely on older local observations.
review_note: Cross-checked the Mammal Diversity Database, a university-hosted taxonomic revision, Cuban bat research and a Spanish regional account; compared it with B. cavernarum and Phyllonycteris poeyi. No Brachyphylla profile is currently in the catalogue.
